description: Twenty-two remaining reviewed P7 routes plus first three P8 routes; four P7 contract gaps remain gated.

deferred.GetInactiveMemberList: Void by-value Object transport is marked unusable in reference source; a live native written-buffer fixture is missing.
deferred.GetAlphaAngleForSection: Native help supplies no interpretable return-status contract; no finite default/output is promoted to certified success.
deferred.GetCentroidLocationForSection: Native return status is undocumented; qualification must establish success/absence before exposing engineering data.
deferred.GetAssignedAttributeByIndex: Index base and native observation-context relationship are not verified; no guessed mapping to a requested entity.

contracts.name: GetFireProofedBeamList
contracts.summary: Reads an owned bounded snapshot of native fireproofed member IDs.
parameters: maximumResults
Allocation limit from 1 through 100000, default 100000. Larger native counts give LimitExceeded before buffer allocation/retrieval.
contracts.returns: Success with a read-only ID list in native order, retaining duplicates. Zero count gives an empty list without list dispatch. False/zero list flag gives NativeFailure; changed counts give StateChanged; failures have no Data.
contracts.remarks: When to use: enumerate fireproofed member IDs without loading beam objects. Uses GetFireProofedBeamCount before and after the flag-returning list call, validates exact rank-one Int32 shape/length and positive written IDs. Equal counts cannot exclude same-count external edits. No assumption about specification indices is made. All native calls use the shared captured-binding gate with before/after lifetime checks. No native model mutation, geometry hydration, unit conversion, save or engineering certification occurs.

contracts.name: CreateUPTTable
contracts.summary: Creates a native user-provided table of an explicit reviewed type.
parameters: tableType
Defined native type 1..10: WideFlange, Channel, Angle, DoubleAngle, Tee, Pipe, Tube, General, ISection or Prismatic. This is not a section property reference or country code.
contracts.returns: Created with a separate positive CreatedTableId for a positive integral native result. -6031 gives InvalidInput; zero/other undocumented responses throw. No section property/specification ID is populated.
contracts.remarks: When to use: create an empty UPT table independently from adding a named section or assigning members. Requests run on the captured native receiver using the reviewed metadata's by-value input, despite C++ VARIANT-reference spelling. No staged workflow/cleanup or table-type lookup is hidden. Input snapshots are validated before native writes. Native acknowledgement is not persistence read-back; partial changes may remain after failure or a stale-binding/transport exception. No hidden save, retry, transaction, unit conversion or rollback occurs.

contracts.signature: PropertyMutationResult AddUPTPropertyWIDEFLANGE(int tableId, string sectionName, UptWideFlangeDefinition definition)
contracts.name: AddUPTPropertyWIDEFLANGE
contracts.summary: Adds an explicit wide-flange section to an existing native UPT table.
parameters: tableId
Positive existing native UPT table ID, not an analytical member or section property ID. Caller must establish that the table type supports the requested insertion.
sectionName
Exact nonblank native UPT section name without NUL. Case/whitespace preserved; no catalog normalization or automatic replacement.
definition

Non-null immutable AX,D,TW,WF,TF,IZ,IY,IX,AY,AZ values in this native order. Required area/dimensions are finite positive; inertias/shear areas finite nonnegative. Areas use length squared, inertia slots length to fourth power, dimensions length. This route documents IZ as torsional constant and IX about local Z; no relabeling from another layout.
contracts.returns: Succeeded for integral zero, NativeFailure for -6032 and AlreadyExists for -6045. Retains actual response and requested TableId/SectionName. No created section property reference or table ID is fabricated.
contracts.remarks: When to use: insert explicit scalar UPT values without silently changing a duplicate named section. Table creation and insertion are separate model mutations; an insertion failure does not remove the table. Vendor metadata accepts inputs by value. Native success does not prove a new definition rather than an accepted insertion and does not assign members. Input snapshots are validated before native writes. Native acknowledgement is not persistence read-back; partial changes may remain after failure or a stale-binding/transport exception. No hidden save, retry, transaction, unit conversion or rollback occurs.

contracts.signature: PropertyMutationResult AddUPTPropertyWIDEFLANGEUNEQUAL(int tableId, string sectionName, UptUnequalWideFlangeDefinition definition)
contracts.name: AddUPTPropertyWIDEFLANGEUNEQUAL
contracts.summary: Adds an explicit unequal wide-flange section through the native twelve-double UPT route.
parameters: tableId
Positive existing native UPT table ID, not an analytical member or section property ID. Caller must establish that the table type supports the requested insertion.
sectionName
Exact nonblank native UPT section name without NUL. Case/whitespace preserved; no catalog normalization or automatic replacement.
definition

Non-null immutable primary AX,D,TW,WF,TF,IZ,IY,IX,AY,AZ values followed by explicit WF1 and TF1 in native slots ten/eleven. A fresh exact twelve-double array is sent by value per reviewed vendor metadata. WF1/TF1 retain native second-flange labels without guessing their physical orientation.
contracts.returns: Succeeded for true/integral one and NativeFailure for false/integral zero. Actual Boolean/integral evidence is retained separately with requested TableId/SectionName; no duplicate-specific status or created section ID is inferred.
contracts.remarks: When to use: insert the unequal shape using its distinct Boolean-returning native route; zero is failure here, unlike the scalar wide-flange route. Input values remain immutable even if a native buffer is altered. Does not create a table, replace a duplicate by fallback, create an assigned property or assign members. Input snapshots are validated before native writes. Native acknowledgement is not persistence read-back; partial changes may remain after failure or a stale-binding/transport exception. No hidden save, retry, transaction, unit conversion or rollback occurs.
